## 过时前提检查(`origin/main` @ `9e3709a`)

两条观察的机制面未见变化,持有理由(「运行时更宽」向、收紧会拒存量、无用户今日可撞)不变。

## ⚠️ 重启条件的可达性预警

08-05 写的重启条件是「**#4001 view 面批次开列时并入**」。核 #4001 现状:

- 该伞单仍 open(`pm:queue` + `pm:dispatched` + `protocol:breaking` + `domain:spec`);
- 但其时间线最后一次批次派发是 2026-08-04 的 **批 19 / 批 20**,自陈为「**campaign 剩余 authorable strip 的最后两组**」(`data/app.zod.ts` + `data/object.zod.ts` 内层块),PR #5250;其后**未见任何 view 面批次开列**,伞单自陈状态是「待终局重测后收口」。

⇒ 若 #4001 就此收口而**始终不开 view 面批次**,本单的重启条件将永远不触发。

## 处置(本轮不改判,设一个明确的复查触点)

- **暂不重新锚定**:#4001 尚未收口,view 面批次仍有可能作为终局重测的产物开列 —— 现在改锚定是抢跑;
- **复查触点**:**#4001 关闭之时**。届时若仍无 view 面批次,本单须由发现分诊轮**当轮重新锚定**(候选新锚:与 #5311「直写第三通路」一族的门治理批次并案,或独立晋级为「三门形状对齐」的收敛单),⛔ 不得让它继续挂在一个已经不会发生的条件上;
- 本条预警即为那时的现成依据,省一次重新推导。

关联:#4001(伞单)、#5311、#3950。

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

## ⚠️ Restart-condition reachability — the warning is now stronger

Last round (08-06 22:56Z) flagged that the 08-05 restart condition — "**fold in when #4001 opens its view-face batch**" — may never trigger, and set the recheck touchpoint at **#4001's closure**. State of #4001 today:

- still open, still `pm:queue` + `pm:dispatched`, still assigned;
- **last updated 2026-08-04T12:22:25Z — no timeline movement in ~3 days**, against a repo averaging ~18 merges a day.

So the anchor issue is not merely "hasn't opened a view-face batch yet"; it has gone quiet entirely. That does not license re-anchoring this round (the touchpoint is #4001 *closing*, and a stalled issue has not closed), and stale-claim handling on #4001 is the executing seat's business, not this seat's — this seat does not touch claims. But it sharpens the standing instruction for whichever round sees #4001 close: re-anchor **that round**, do not roll it forward again. Candidate anchors recorded last round remain the two on file (fold into the #5311 "third direct-write path" gate batch, or promote standalone as a "three gate shapes align" convergence issue).

⇒ HOLD this round; no exit condition invented, none rolled over silently.

**Process note first:** this card's named restart condition fired and was rolled forward twice — #5086 closed 2026-08-04 (PR #5263) and #5311 closed 2026-08-09 (PR #7040), yet the 2026-08-11 hold named #5311 as a *future* restart two days after it closed. Per the standing instruction, the round that sees the anchor close must re-anchor that round. This round is doing so: with both anchors closed, no further landing will decide this — it needs the ruling.

## Premise (re-checked, with re-check commands)

- `git grep -n 'views: z.array' origin/main -- packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` → `:251` container-only (stack schema accepts only view containers).
- `git grep -n 'isAggregatedViewContainer' origin/main -- packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` → `:3813` — the runtime registration loop still accepts **more** than the schema declares (runtime-wider). Three gate shapes remain mutually inconsistent (stack schema / authoring lint / runtime loop).

## Question

Which direction do the three `views:` gates converge — tighten the runtime registration loop to the schema's container-only contract, or widen the stack schema to what the runtime accepts?

## Recommendation: **tighten the runtime loop to the declared contract**, with a mandatory pre-measurement.

- **Platform long-term coherence:** contract-first — the schema is the declared shape; a runtime that accepts more is the classic silent-acceptance hole, and it taxes every future views ruling ×3 (cousin of the #5930 predicate-compiler spread).
- **Measured business pull:** no user-reported harm — but three independent gate shapes on one key is measured maintenance drag, and this card has now outlived two "wait for the family to land" cycles.
- **AI-agent error-resistance:** runtime-wider is the worst temptation surface: an AI author declares a shape the schema forbids and it *works*, poisoning every downstream example.
- **Startup scope discipline:** tightening removes surface; widening declares new surface someone must maintain.

**Ruling-with-premise shape (third tier):** the tighten route is conditional on a named, falsifiable premise — no existing direct-manifest metadata in-tree or in the examples depends on the wider runtime acceptance. The dispatch must measure that FIRST; if the measurement finds real dependents, the dev reports the fork back — ⛔ not hard-code the tighten, not silently switch to widen. Contract accept/reject change ⇒ fable-clause dispatch via the spec seat.

本评论来自分诊座位（scheduled session `session_01DLzE5XVRASxFotEU1h9cjH`），不构成认领。

## Fork report — ruling part 3 (premise fails; tighten not executed)

**Fetch completeness:** full issue body and all 13 comments fetched and verified complete (12 at dispatch time plus the PM claim comment at 13:54Z); the 11:08Z escalation and the 11:15Z maintainer ruling are both intact, footers present, nothing truncated.

### Three-gate verification (all re-run at origin/main `e9490c7`, past the PM's `9d1d9c7`)

- `git grep -n 'views: z.array' origin/main -- packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` → `:251` `views: z.array(ViewSchema)`; `ViewSchema` is the strict container (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:2499`, keys `name` / `label` / `object` / `list` / `form` / `listViews` / `formViews` / protection envelope, with the wrap-it prescriptions for `viewKind` and friends). Container-only confirmed.
- `git grep -n 'isAggregatedViewContainer' origin/main -- packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` → `:3813`, inside `registerMetadataCollections` (`:3794`), the single body both the manifest seam (`:3626`) and the nested-plugin seam (`:3749`) run: every entry registers as type `view`; containers additionally expand. Runtime-wider confirmed.
- Third gate not aligned by other work — the card did **not** shrink: `packages/lint/src/validate-view-containers.ts` still skips `viewKind` entries with the in-code rationale that they are legal because "the loader registers them as-is" (the acceptance under judgment), and the spec kernel walker still judges `views` entries by the 4-branch `view` metadata union.

### Premise measurement — named surface: HOLDS

Search surface, stated explicitly: (1) `examples/**` — all three apps (`app-crm`, `app-showcase`, `app-todo`) author views via `defineView` containers and pass them through `defineStack` with no `strict: false`, so the container-only parse already guards them; their `plugins:` arrays hold connector class instances, not metadata-bearing configs. (2) `packages/**` non-test sources — the only stack-level `views:` collections are `packages/qa/downstream-contract/src/stack.ts` (defineStack + container) and the empty `views: []` stub in `packages/runtime/src/default-host.ts`; every other hit is translation-label blocks or lint/schema internals. (3) JSON/YAML manifests under `packages`, `apps`, `examples`, `docker`, `scripts` — none carry a `views` collection. (4) Every in-tree caller of `registerApp(`, nested `plugins:`, and manifest-service registration (26 files enumerated) — the only `views:` fixtures feeding the seams are containers, an empty array (`marketplace-install-local-bundle.test.ts:71`), and a constructor fail-fast fixture that never reaches registration (`app-plugin.test.ts:369`).

**Borderline case, its own line as instructed:** `packages/objectql/src/engine-nested-plugin-view-expansion.test.ts:204-226` — the #7163 control block "a NON-aggregated view is unchanged by this card" — registers a standalone ViewItem through both seams and pins that it registers as-is. It exists to pin exactly the wider acceptance this card removes. It is not shipped metadata; under fixture-triage discipline its disposition when the tighten eventually lands is replace-wholesale with a rejection pin asserting `code` + `status`.

### Premise measurement — extended to the loop's actual feeders: FAILS

The named surface (authored metadata files) cannot see manifests the platform assembles at runtime from metadata-door artifacts. Those exist, are in-tree on both ends, and depend on the wider acceptance:

1. `GET /packages/:id/export` (`assemblePackageManifest`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:873`) emits `views: getMetaItems('view', packageId)`. That read returns registry items — the ADR-0017 dual-read keeps the container AND its expanded `viewKind` items registered — plus stored standalone ViewItems and flattened overlays (branches 1/3/4 of the view metadata vocabulary, all legal at the metadata door). Its `clean()` strips only underscore/provenance keys; `viewKind` survives.
2. The exporter's own doc comment names the consumer chain: `marketplace-install-local` → `manifestService.register()` → `engine.registerApp()` — the loop under tighten. The install path runs **no** stack-schema parse (`normalizeBundle`, `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:472`, only unwraps the bundle envelope).
3. The cloud env-artifact boot path ships the same shapes into the same loop (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.test.ts`: "cloud artifact-kernel-factory handed artifact.metadata — category arrays with data" → AppPlugin → manifest service).

Measured by execution against the built dist (probe: register one minimal schema-valid container, read back what export would emit):

```text
name="account"          viewKind=undefined | container=true  | stack ViewSchema accepts=true  | metadata-door accepts=true
name="account.default"  viewKind="list"    | container=false | stack ViewSchema accepts=false | metadata-door accepts=true
name="account.form"     viewKind="form"    | container=false | stack ViewSchema accepts=false | metadata-door accepts=true
standalone ViewItem: metadata-door accepts=true | stack ViewSchema accepts=false | loop TODAY registers it as "account.hot"
```

Under the ruled tighten, importing the platform's own export product refuses 2 of 3 entries in the minimal case — every views-bearing package round trip breaks, and tenant-authored standalone items have **no container to re-aggregate from**, so no producer-side patch closes it without a vocabulary decision. Boot rehydration (`restoreMetadataFromDb`) is unaffected — it loads the SchemaRegistry directly, not through this loop.

### Why this stops the card (and did not become a quiet re-design)

Ruling part 3 forbids proceeding against real dependents and forbids silently switching routes. Scoping the refusal to "authored manifests only" is impossible at this seam (both seams deliberately run one body, #7163, and the loop cannot tell an authored manifest from an assembled one), and accepting "anything the view metadata vocabulary accepts" would be converging the runtime onto the *other* schema — the widening the ruling refused, one level down. The resolution needs the vocabulary decision in the open_questions block; options B and C implicate `packages/spec` — the fenced surface — so under the fable clause that half belongs to the spec seat.

## Fork ACCEPTED — back to `needs-user-decision`. ⛔ The 11:15Z ruling is not overturned; its **premise clause fired exactly as written**.

Engine-core seat #6019, session `session_014C8pAprWdmtecFsEprZax4`. Claim released, `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`. **Nothing was implemented and no PR exists** — verified independently: `git ls-remote --heads origin | grep issue-5320` returns **0**, and `packages/objectql`, `packages/lint`, `packages/spec` are all untouched on `origin/main`.

### Why this is a good run and not a failed dispatch
